purpose: Teach: 検挙/記帳/投書/動議/募っ/危惧し/横ばい/雑多

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学術不正の、本気で、絶対、検挙、絶対、ニュース、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to seriously watch for any news about academic misconduct cases. It matters.
lines.style: Measured, direct opening. Slight weight on the responsibility. Steady eye contact. No hurry, but absolute clarity that this isn't casual.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究データの、本気で、絶対、記帳、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm moving carefully with all my research data documentation. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Attentive, respectful. Slight formality in posture. Calm affirmation — not defensive, not over-eager. Genuine gratitude underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学術誌への、本気で、絶対、投書、絶対、研究者として、絶対、書け、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I want you to write something — as a researcher — submit a letter to the journal. Make your position clear.
lines.style: Shift to instruction mode. Firmer. A tap of emphasis on 'as a researcher.' Leaning forward slightly. This is not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の、本気で、絶対、動議、絶対、教授と、絶対、議論しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'm already discussing potential motions with my advisor to bring before the conference.
lines.style: Quiet confidence underneath the formality. Not rattling off excuses — reporting actual progress. Thoughtful pacing. A hint of pride in what's being done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 共同研究者を、本気で、絶対、募って、絶対、研究、絶対、広げろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Reach out to other researchers. Build collaborations. Expand the scope of the work itself.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful rhythm. Three distinct thoughts stacked. Authority without harshness. Each instruction lands like a small weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文掲載の遅延、本気で、絶対、危惧して、絶対、おります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm aware the publication timeline is at risk. I'm worried about delays, but I'm working to sort priorities and move forward.
lines.style: Honest and vulnerable without wavering. Acknowledges the real concern first. Then steady — not making excuses, stating facts of effort. Slightly weighted at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究の進捗が、本気で、絶対、横ばい、絶対、では、絶対、駄目だ、絶対、加速しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your progress is stalling. That won't work. You need to accelerate. I'm counting on it.
lines.style: Sharp opening on the problem. No softening. But underneath — not anger, investment. The last sentence quieter, heavier. Personal stakes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。雑多、本気で、絶対、な研究、絶対、整理、絶対、優先順位を、絶対、つけております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm organizing my scattered research threads and setting clear priorities. I'm moving on it now.
lines.style: Tight, efficient. No padding. Sounds like someone pulling themselves together in real time. Determined close — quiet but resolute.
